items_list.fact: 1. Causal pass: the prompt as normal, the causal features the model was pretrained to consume

items_list.fact: 2. Bidirectional pass: same prompt, mask removed, each prompt token sees the whole instruction

items_list.fact: So the model can treat the two feature types differently instead of interpreting bidirectional features through weights trained on causal ones
